verdict.rationale: Baseten's own docs say async inference can deliver results via an outbound webhook callback, which is a real HTTP callback a program can receive. It is scoped to completion of individual async inference requests, not a general event-subscription system. missing for 10: subscribable events beyond async inference (deployments, training jobs, billing), webhook registration/management docs, signing/retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Async inference returns a request ID quickly and completes later through webhook or polling, which suits batch work, long documents, or any case where the caller should not hold a connection open for minutes.
